transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
My wife thinks I’m not eating enough. Most days I’ll have coffee and toast in the morning, then maybe some soup or vegetables later on. Big meals just seem unnecessary at my age.
How has your mood been lately?
I’m not sure what you mean exactly. I’ve been getting along, I suppose. Nothing in particular stands out to me.
Have you or your family noticed any problems with your memory recently?
I haven’t noticed any real problems with my memory. My wife hasn’t mentioned anything like that either, as far as I know.
Can you tell me more about why you feel big meals are unnecessary for you?
I just don’t feel I need that much food anymore. Coffee and toast in the morning is usually enough, and later I might have some soup or vegetables. A big meal feels unnecessary at my age.
Do you feel that your body or digestive organs are working properly?
As far as I can tell, things are working properly. I haven’t noticed anything that makes me think otherwise.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy doing?
No, I don’t think so. I still enjoy the things I usually do.
Are you worried about gaining weight or trying to change how your body looks?
Yes. When my wife puts butter on something or gives me a full plate, I get nervous I’ll start gaining the weight back. I’ve worked hard to keep control of it, and I don’t want to lose that.
What is your current weight?
My doctor says my weight has gotten too low. I don’t know the exact number, but I feel lighter, and that makes it easier for me to get around the garden and keep up with my walks.
Have you noticed any change in your sexual desire or drive recently?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to that lately.
Have you experienced any difficulty getting or maintaining an erection?
I’m not sure, doctor. I haven’t really paid attention to that lately.
Even though your doctor says your weight is too low, do you still feel that you are overweight or too fat?

I suppose I do worry about it. If my belt is a notch looser, I feel like I’ve done right by myself. But if I catch my stomach looking even a little rounded in the mirror, I feel sloppy and disappointed.
Do you go on walks or exercise specifically to burn calories or prevent yourself from gaining weight?

I don’t really exercise much, but I do get nervous about gaining weight. When my wife puts butter on something or gives me a full plate, I worry I’ll start putting it back on and lose the control I’ve managed to keep.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating to prevent weight gain?
No, I don’t do that.
Do you take any medications, such as laxatives, water pills, or diet pills, to help control your weight?
I’m not sure what all counts as those. I haven’t noticed taking anything specifically for my weight.
Do you know what your height is, or roughly how much weight you have lost?
I don’t know the exact numbers. My doctor says the scale has gotten too low, but honestly, being lighter makes it easier for me to get around the garden and keep up on my walks.
Has your medical doctor ever told you that your hormone levels, such as your testosterone, are abnormally low?
I’m not sure. I don’t recall my doctor saying anything specifically about testosterone or hormone levels.
Do you have a specific maximum weight or target number on the scale that you refuse to go above?
I don’t have a particular number in mind. But when my wife puts butter on my food or gives me a full plate, I get nervous I’ll start gaining it back and lose the control I’ve worked to keep.
Have you noticed whether you still wake up with morning erections?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to that.
Have you noticed yourself feeling unusually sensitive to the cold or needing extra layers to stay warm?
I don’t know about the cold, exactly. My doctor does say my weight has gotten too low, but I feel lighter and able to get around the garden and keep up with my walks better.
When you and your wife are intimate, are you still physically able to achieve an erection and engage in intercourse?
I’m not sure, doctor. My wife and I haven’t really talked about that much, and I haven’t paid close attention to whether I can or can’t.
